# Xolo Guides

> A comprehensive resource for freelancers and self-employed professionals navigating tax, legal, and business setup requirements across Spain and Italy.

Xolo Guides provides practical, localized guidance for independent professionals including freelancers, solopreneurs, and self-employed workers. The site covers career-specific setup guides, regional tax deductions, invoicing requirements, and compliance information tailored to Spanish and Italian regulations.

## Key Topics

- Self-employment (autonomo/libero professionista)
- Spanish Income Tax (IRPF/Renta)
- VAT (Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido)
- Social Security (Seguridad Social)
- Regional Tax Deductions
- Partita IVA (Italy)
- Freelance Marketing
- Digital Certificates
- Professional Invoicing
- Work-Life Balance
- Agencia Tributaria
- Tax Compliance
- Career Setup Guides
- Spain & Italy Regulations

## Freelance Career Guides by Profession

- [Beginner's Guide to Working as a Freelance Developer](https://guides.xolo.io/beginners-guide-to-working-as-a-freelance-developer): Getting started guide for freelance web developers
- [The Unrivaled Guide to Starting Your Freelance Career in Digital Marketing](https://guides.xolo.io/the-unrivaled-guide-to-starting-your-freelance-career-in-digital-marketing): Comprehensive guide to digital marketing freelance career
- [Trabajar como freelance de marketing digital en España](https://guides.xolo.io/es-es/trabajar-como-freelance-de-marketing-digital): Guide to starting digital marketing freelance career in Spain
- [Trabajar en España como fotógrafo freelance: una guía para empezar](https://guides.xolo.io/es-es/trabajar-en-espa%C3%B1a-como-fot%C3%B3grafo-freelance): Getting started guide for freelance photographers in Spain
- [Trabajar como traductor freelance en España](https://guides.xolo.io/es-es/trabajar-como-traductor-freelance): Getting started guide for freelance translators in Spain

## Professional Registration & Setup (Italy)

- [Come aprire la partita IVA da psicologo: guida per aspiranti liberi professionisti](https://guides.xolo.io/it-it/apertura-partita-iva-per-professioni/come-aprire-la-partita-iva-da-psicologo): Guide to opening VAT ID for psychologists in Italy
- [Come aprire la partita IVA da copywriter: guida per aspiranti liberi professionisti](https://guides.xolo.io/it-it/apertura-partita-iva-per-professioni/come-aprire-la-partita-iva-da-copywriter): Guide to opening VAT ID for copywriters in Italy
- [Come aprire la partita IVA da architetto: guida per aspiranti liberi professionisti](https://guides.xolo.io/it-it/apertura-partita-iva-per-professioni/come-aprire-la-partita-iva-da-architetto): Guide to opening VAT ID for architects in Italy

- [Regional Deduction Rules in La Rioja - Renta 2024](https://guides.xolo.io/es-en/la-rioja-regional-deductions): Tax deductions and benefits guide for La Rioja region
- [Regional Deduction Rules in Baleares](https://guides.xolo.io/es-en/baleares-regional-deductions): Tax deductions and benefits guide for Baleares region
- [Regional Deduction Rules in Castilla y León - Renta 2023](https://guides.xolo.io/es-en/castilla-y-le%C3%B3n-regional-deductions-): Tax deductions and benefits guide for Castilla y León

## Invoicing, Accounting & Compliance

- [Freelance accounting in Spain: The good, the bad, and the ugly](https://guides.xolo.io/es-en/freelance-accounting-in-spain-the-good-the-bad-and-the-ugly): Freelance accounting and bookkeeping guide for Spain

- [Certificado digital](https://guides.xolo.io/es-es/certificado-digital): Digital certificate and electronic signature explained
